# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Bandle leaderboards

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

Bandle rankings for daily, weekly, monthly and all-time periods.

### `GET /api/dailychallenge/leaderboard/today` — Get the daily leaderboard

Auth: none

Returns today's top players. `limit` defaults to 100. `mode` selects the challenge variant. Defaults to Normal.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | `int` | no | default: 100 |
| `mode` | query | `int` | no | Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme; Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  date: date-time
  mode: int  // Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme
  songId: string | null
  songTitle: string | null
  totalPlayers: int
  totalPlaysIncludingGuests: int
  totalWins: int
  totalLosses: int
  winRate: double  // read-only
  lossRate: double  // read-only
  entries: {
    userId: string | null
    username: string | null
    userAvatarUrl: string | null
    rank: int
    score: int
    badge: string | null
    frameTheme: int  // Possible values: `0` = None, `1` = Evolved, `2` = Awakened, `3` = Transcendent, `4` = Ascended, `5` = Mythic, `6` = Apex
    date: date-time
    attemptNumber: int
    timeSpent: date-span
    completedAt: date-time
    isPerfect: bool
  }[] | null
  lastUpdated: date-time
  averageAttempt: double
  perfectScoreCount: int
  attemptDistribution: { [key: string]: int } | null
  isInvalid: bool
  invalidationMessage: string | null
}
```

Response `500` Internal Server Error

### `GET /api/dailychallenge/leaderboard/user/{userId}/ranks` — Get a user's ranks

Auth: none

Returns the specified user's rank on each leaderboard.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `userId` | path | `string` | yes |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  userId: string | null
  username: string | null
  dailyRank: int | null
  weeklyRank: int | null
  monthlyRank: int | null
  globalRank: int | null
  currentStreak: int
  longestStreak: int
}
```

Response `400` Bad Request `application/json`:

```ts
{
  type: string | null
  title: string | null
  status: int | null
  detail: string | null
  instance: string | null
  [key: string]: any  // extra keys allowed
}
```

Response `500` Internal Server Error
